works.body:
Hello!  Nice to meet you, I really liked the clothes you designed, so I was wondering if you can design some clothes for my OC.
They are a couple.The girl is rabbit-liked, has dark blue eyes and is 155cm. The boy has gray eyes and is 175cm.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1827GcMq_kXToeYKp8mlX84fC7n2CRipr?usp=sharing

I also liked to chibi (deformed) style maid costume you drew for your own OC, so I was wondering if I can also request for one of those. Please feel free to raise the money.
Thank you so much for taking the time to read my long request! I truly love your artwork with all my heart.
